description: NEGATIVE-finding guard. AST-scans production compute (computations/, excluding _deprecated/, probes/, data/) and fails if any script imports, defines, or uses a PURGED non-canonical form. Registry: lambda_scale_yekutieli_extended (Yekutieli −G·h² correction, falsified PR #985/#1027), lambda_scale_family_a (lambda-scale alias, removed PR #1089), the lambda_scale_* symbol prefix (owner directive 'no lambda-scale ANYWHERE in production'), and the purged module lambda_yekutieli_extended_borromean. Uses AST so historical mentions in comments/docstrings are not false-positives. Detection covers direct imports, module-as-symbol imports (from pkg import <banned-module>), def, bare-name use, and attribute access (mod.<banned>); strict mode also fails on unparseable production scripts so there is no blind spot. Keeps the documented purges durable against silent sibling-branch re-entry.
